<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

A client of an API outside the app (an affiliate program, a messaging bot, a payment provider), used by name: blueprint integration shopee. Generated in internal/integrations/&lt;name>: retries with backoff that respect Retry-After, a rate limit, a timeout, secrets from the environment kept out of errors and logs, and, with observability, a span and the client's metrics for each call. Yours, in &lt;name>.go, written once: how a request is authenticated and the API's calls. Every module gets the client in its Deps; &lt;name>test serves a fake API for tests, and &lt;app> &lt;name> check calls the real one with an environment's secrets.

```esquadro
blueprint integration
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [app](../app/), [domain](../domain/), [env](../env/): the app must use them too.

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `url` | string | `""` | The API's address: https://open-api.affiliate.shopee.com.br. The &lt;NAME>_URL variable changes it per environment. |
| `rate_limit` | string | `"0"` | How many requests at most, in this process: 2/s, 120/min, 1000/h; 0, none. |
| `retries` | int | `3` | How many more times a call is tried when the API fails for a moment (429, 502, 503, 504, a connection lost), waiting longer each time. |
| `timeout` | string | `"30s"` | How long a call may take, its tries included: 30s, 1m. |
| `key` | bool | `false` | The API takes a key (an app id, a bot's token): &lt;NAME>_KEY. |
| `secret` | bool | `false` | The API takes a secret (to sign requests with): &lt;NAME>_SECRET. |

```esquadro
blueprint integration {
  url "value"
}
```

## Environment variables

Read when the app starts; see [Environment variables](/esquadro/language/environment/).

| Variable | Type | Value | |
|---|---|---|---|
| `INSTANCE_URL` | string | the url option | The API's address; the url option by default. |
| `INSTANCE_KEY` | string, secret, required outside development | - | The API's key. |
| `INSTANCE_SECRET` | string, secret, required outside development | - | The API's secret. |
